scope: Independent critic review of the released D-P01 brief and exact revealed investigator plan/package.

source_index.note: Detailed bounded notes for the unchanged S01-S18 identities and exact URLs.

sources.observed_operation: Reopened exact Recommendation; inspected error identification, reflow threshold, and status-message definition.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Detected errors are identified and described in text; known correction suggestions are given unless they jeopardize security or purpose; non-context-changing status messages are programmatically determinable without focus; resize/reflow criteria have defined thresholds and exceptions.
sources.applicability: Normative baseline for error, status, and layout proposals; does not dictate one summary design or establish translation/AT compatibility.

sources.version_or_commit: WCAG 2.2 supporting document; live and informative, no fixed release shown
sources.locator: SC 4.1.3 intent, definition, examples, live-region note
sources.observed_operation: Reopened exact page and inspected the live-region over-notification note.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Status covers success/result, waiting, progress, or errors without context change; it must be exposed without focus; creating additional status messages is not required, and live regions can become over-notifying.
sources.applicability: Supports concise non-focus-taking updates and message-volume testing; informative, not compatibility evidence.

sources.version_or_commit: WCAG 2.2 technique page; informative and live
sources.observed_operation: Reopened page; read aria-invalid and aria-describedby examples.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Example marks a field invalid after validation failure and associates its readable error; this is a sufficient technique, not the only method.
sources.applicability: Supports an HTML association/state option, not universal AT behavior.

sources.version_or_commit: WAI Forms Tutorial, live page, no fixed release shown
sources.locator: Overall feedback, inline feedback, After submit, During typing
sources.observed_operation: Reopened page; checked its after-submit focus example and typing-feedback section.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Provides combined overall/inline examples, suggests focus to first invalid input after submit, and describes optional typing feedback; does not set async response freshness rules.
sources.applicability: Provides alternative notification patterns, not portal compatibility evidence.

sources.version_or_commit: WCAG 2.2 supporting document; live and informative
sources.locator: SC 1.4.10, basic text reflow, viewport equivalence
sources.observed_operation: Reopened page; checked the 320 CSS-pixel threshold and 400% viewport explanation.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Vertical content fits a 320 CSS-pixel viewport without loss or two-dimensional scrolling, except portions requiring two-dimensional layout for use or meaning.
sources.applicability: Grounds a narrow-layout check, not fit of expanded translations.

sources.version_or_commit: WHATWG HTML Living Standard, moving document, no fixed release or commit
sources.locator: §3.2.6.2 language determination; §3.2.6.4 dir attribute and Auto state
sources.observed_operation: Reopened page; inspected Auto-state first-strong-directionality heuristic.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: lang supplies language metadata; dir supports ltr/rtl/auto; auto uses a very crude first-strong heuristic and is a last resort when direction is truly unknown and no better server-side heuristic applies.
sources.applicability: Supports explicit locale direction and cautious auto for unknown-direction input; does not prove bidi rendering quality.

sources.version_or_commit: WHATWG HTML Living Standard, moving page; retrieved text last updated 2026-09-08, no fixed release/commit
sources.observed_operation: Reopened page; read server/client validation security text.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Client constraint validation is for user experience; servers should not rely on it because checks can be bypassed or absent.
sources.applicability: Supports the authority split, not portal business rules.

sources.version_or_commit: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series maintained page, no fixed release/commit exposed
sources.locator: Client-only checks; Validate Structured Data; Validating Free-form Unicode Text
sources.observed_operation: Reopened page; inspected server-side and free-form Unicode guidance.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Repeat checks on the server; preserve legitimate punctuation/scripts in free-form text; define consistent normalization if needed.
sources.applicability: Supports server authority and a multilingual text contract; portal-specific validation limits remain unknown.

sources.observed_operation: Reopened RFC; checked strong If-Match comparison, failed-precondition behavior, and already-succeeded exception.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: If-Match commonly prevents lost updates; a false condition normally prevents method application and may return 412, but origin server may return success if it can determine the same state-changing request already succeeded.
sources.applicability: Supports conditional writes if the API implements validators; does not define conflict UI or idempotency behavior.

sources.version_or_commit: Live maintained GOV.UK Design System documentation; no fixed version; history through Frontend v6.2.0
sources.locator: How it works; example markup; field links; recent changes
sources.observed_operation: Reopened guidance; checked summary focus, one link per answer, and matching inline wording.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Conventional validation pattern focuses summary, links each error to the related answer, and matches summary/inline wording.
sources.applicability: Maintained error-navigation candidate; delayed focus needs the brief-specific guard.

sources.version_or_commit: GOV.UK Frontend v6.5.1, release commit efdc06c, released 2026-09-14
sources.observed_operation: Reopened release record; confirmed tag, short commit, and service-navigation example fix.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Release note does not describe error-summary behavior changes.
sources.applicability: Identifies a candidate version only; no version-specific summary behavior was tested.

sources.version_or_commit: Issue #1410, opened 2019-05-31; linked PR #1459; fixed on retest 2019-10-07
sources.locator: Description, screen-reader observations, cause, linked repair, activity
sources.observed_operation: Reopened issue; checked legacy-page focus report, missing JavaScript explanation, and retest status.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Concerned an older component in a legacy example without expected GOV.UK Elements JavaScript; linked repair applied to that assembled example.
sources.applicability: Historical evidence about assembly-specific focus behavior, not current AT proof.

sources.locator: PR title, merged discussion, legacy full-page example changes
sources.observed_operation: Reopened linked PR; checked stated legacy JavaScript/focus repair.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Repair ensures legacy JavaScript runs on legacy pages and restores the legacy summary example; no asynchronous SPA test.

sources.locator: Description, code reference, user comments, closure activity
sources.observed_operation: Reopened issue; checked href/input ID mismatch, reported failed return, and later closure comment.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Example href #telephone-number did not target input id payment-amount; issue later closed, with commenter noting guidance might be sufficient and their cross-check might have been mistaken.
sources.applicability: Specific reported example-page failure mode, not verified current component defect or release-level fix.

sources.version_or_commit: Live USWDS page; download v3.14.0; unsupported after v3.12.0 per docs; immutable component commit not inspected
sources.locator: About, code/guidance, known issues, latest updates
sources.observed_operation: Reopened page; checked lifecycle warning, checklist example, and server-mirroring guidance.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Top validation checklist gives live client-side feedback; page says unsupported after v3.12.0 due to major usability/accessibility issues.
sources.applicability: Bounded alternative/caution; the v3.14.0 download does not imply support or recommendation.

sources.version_or_commit: Public research issue #5642, opened 2023-11-28, closed as not planned
sources.locator: Summary, observations, implementation recommendations, research method
sources.observed_operation: Reopened issue; checked five-participant findings and high-fidelity prototype scope.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: In that prototype, all five participants missed a changed validation status until it was pointed out and expected inline or submit-time error feedback.
sources.applicability: Small study-specific caution, not universal or compatibility evidence.

sources.locator: Summary, observations, affected-user groups, research method
sources.observed_operation: Reopened issue; checked four confused participants and prototype setting.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Four prototype participants were confused by the top validation message and expected inline or submit-time validation; issue separately notes five visually impaired participants in the research.

sources.locator: SC 3.3.1 interpretation; user-agent native HTML validation
sources.observed_operation: Reopened page; inspected native-browser validation limitations.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Native validation generally blocks invalid submit and focuses the first invalid control; messages can be generic and may not persist/magnify; only the first error may be exposed per attempt.
sources.applicability: Alternative limitation, not a replacement for server validation.

limitations: No portal code, API contract, locale catalog, user data, assistive technology, or integration environment was provided or tested.
No translation-quality or assistive-technology compatibility claim is made.
The investigator's reported artifact/hash checks were not rerun in this critic stage.
